About - GM Print Design About GM Print Design Skip to content GM Print Design Freelance Print & Textile Design Menu Close work services about shop About work services about collection GM Print Design is a UK-based textile print studio with a team of global designers, creating unique, trend-led, production-ready designs for fashion brands . With 15+ years’ fashion industry and practical production experience, we know how to transform directional creative ideas into best-selling prints. From striking florals to innovative abstract animal prints, our collections blend originality, trend relevance, and commercial impact. We understand the pressures of fast-moving fashion. Our process is built for creativity and ease. Every design we sell is fully production-ready- Supplied as layered PSD files in seamless industry-standard sized repeats. All designs are supplied in two colour ways and colour-separated, ready for rotary production We work with buyers, designers, and creative directors at established fashion brands and ambitious fashion startups worldwide. Our partners value creativity originality & commercial focus. Contact: georgina@gmprintdesign.com Instagram Explore the latest collection Print Design & Trend Forecasting georgina@gmprintdesign.com Instagram LinkedIn Privacy Policy Terms and Conditions Instagram Print Design & Trend Forecasting London georgina@gmprintdesign.com Proudly powered by WordPress .

Shop - GM Print Design Print Shop Skip to content GM Print Design Freelance Print & Textile Design Menu Close work services about shop Shop work services about collection Buy Exclusive Textile Prints Online – GM Print Design Studio Shop creative and unique, exclusive, production ready textile prints designs for fashion from the convenience of where you are, anytime. Designs available instantly from catwalk reactive prints, beautiful florals and abstract animal prints. All prints are are sold in two colourways, with artwork files provided in seamless repeat and colour separated for production. All prints are original and sold on an exclusive basis – once sold, you will own the copyright and the design is instantly removed from the shop. Explore the latest collection To sign up for a sneak peek of the latest prints sign up to our newsletter here .
